hero.title: Enameloplasty
hero.subtitle: Tooth Contouring
hero.tagline: Refine. Reshape. Reveal Your Perfect Smile.
hero.paragraph1: Sometimes, the smallest imperfections can make the biggest difference in your smile. That's where Enameloplasty, also known as tooth reshaping or contouring comes in. This quick, painless cosmetic procedure gently refines the edges and surfaces of your teeth for a more symmetrical, smooth, and attractive smile.
hero.paragraph2: At Prudentia Micro Dental Care, Pimple Saudagar we specialize in precise, minimally invasive cosmetic enhancements using the latest micro-dentistry techniques.

whatIs.title: What Is Enameloplasty?
whatIs.paragraph1: Enameloplasty is a non-invasive cosmetic treatment that uses a specialized high-speed dental instrument to gently polish and shape the outer layer of your teeth enamel.
whatIs.paragraph2: Whether it's smoothing a slightly pointy tooth, refining uneven edges, or blending away a tiny chip, this technique sculpts your teeth with absolute precision without drilling or anesthesia.
whatIs.paragraph3: Often combined with treatments like cosmetic bonding, enameloplasty can dramatically enhance the balance and harmony of your smile in a single visit.

whatCanCorrect.title: What Can Enameloplasty Correct?
whatCanCorrect.intro: This subtle but powerful technique is ideal for correcting:

items.title: Minor Chips & Edges
items.description: Smooths rough edges and small chips for a more polished appearance

items.title: Irregular Teeth
items.description: Evens out teeth that have slight irregularities in size or shape

items.title: Overlapping Teeth
items.description: Refines areas where teeth slightly overlap for a more aligned look

items.title: Pointy Contours
items.description: Softens pointed canines or jagged edges for a friendlier smile

items.title: Surface Flaws
items.description: Addresses minor surface imperfections affecting aesthetics

items.title: Balance & Harmony
items.description: Creates better proportion and symmetry across your smile

whatCanCorrect.footer: Typically performed on the front teeth, enameloplasty can instantly make your smile look more aligned, balanced, and polished—without altering your natural tooth structure in a major way.

treatmentExperience.title: What's the Treatment Like?

points.title: No Drills or Injections
points.description: The process is so gentle that numbing isn't required

points.title: Immediate Results
points.description: Leave the chair with a smoother, more refined smile

treatmentExperience.footer: Our expert, Dr. Bhushan, uses specialized buffing tools under high magnification to ensure the most accurate and conservative enamel adjustments—preserving your tooth strength while enhancing its shape.

safety.title: Is It Safe?
safety.description: Yes, absolutely safe and conservative. Enameloplasty only removes a microscopic amount of enamel, leaving your teeth healthy, strong, and fully functional. There's no pain, no downtime, and no long-term impact on tooth integrity.
safety.subtitle: A Subtle Touch for a Stunning Smile
safety.footer: If you're looking for a simple, quick, and affordable way to upgrade your smile, enameloplasty might be the perfect solution. It's ideal for patients who want cosmetic improvements without extensive dental work.

items.question: How long does deep cleaning take?
items.answer: Treatment usually takes one or two visits depending on the severity of gum disease and the amount of plaque buildup.

items.question: Is Scaling & Root Planing painful?
items.answer: Most patients experience minimal discomfort. Local anesthesia may be used when deeper cleaning below the gum line is required.

items.question: How often should I get deep cleaning?
items.answer: Your dentist will recommend the appropriate schedule based on your gum health. Patients with periodontal disease may require regular maintenance visits.

items.question: Who needs deep cleaning?
items.answer: Patients with gum disease, bleeding gums, deep gum pockets, tartar buildup, or chronic bad breath are often good candidates after a dental examination.

items.question: What is the cost of deep cleaning in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the extent of treatment required and the severity of periodontal disease. A consultation provides an accurate treatment estimate.

items.question: Why choose deep cleaning instead of regular cleaning?
items.answer: Deep cleaning removes bacteria and tartar below the gum line, helping treat gum disease and prevent tooth loss, whereas regular cleaning mainly removes deposits above the gums.

items.question: How do I find the best Deep Cleaning (Scaling & Root Planing) near me?
items.answer: Choose a dental clinic with experienced dentists, advanced equipment, excellent patient reviews, modern sterilization standards, and a convenient location.
